submission.natural_language_explanation: The negative pole of L14/N4395 is the non-notice counterpart of this neuron's website cookie-consent detector: it fires at weak-to-moderate baseline strength (peaking ~0.25-0.50 of its 0.46 max) on common function words, pronouns, determiners, and clause-internal content words (such as 'your', 'with', 'our', 'all', or punctuation) across ordinary prose, technical text, and non-notice sentences where the SwiGLU gate remains closed (g < 0). In contrast, inside website cookie-consent or tracking notice boilerplate (such as 'This website uses cookies to improve your experience' or 'By using this site you agree to our use of cookies'), the gate opens positive to drive the positive pole, completely suppressing this negative pole to near zero (< 0.03).
